ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  India Power Corporation Limited, already undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) since May 2026, has received a notice from the Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO) initiating an investigation into its affairs. This probe, following insolvency, significantly escalates legal and reputational risks. A major red flag is the company's assertion that this investigation will have "no impact" on its financial or operational activities, which is highly unlikely given the severe circumstances.
